meta.title: Doxa people groups — what the gospel is available in, and what is missing
meta.grain: one row per people group on Doxa's roster
meta.source: pray.doxa.life roster joined to the resource index by ISO 639-3
meta.definition: Access says what a person in this group can DO in their own language. "Nothing found" means no pool this build can reach holds anything for their language — never a claim that nothing exists. "Watch or hear, cannot read" is the translation brief: they can receive the gospel and cannot yet study it. A BRIDGE LANGUAGE is a language already spoken widely in their country that does have Scripture and the film. It is a way in, not a translation: a group with a bridge is still counted as having nothing, because they still have nothing in the language they think in. A BRIDGE CANDIDATE is weaker still: it is the largest language in their country that has Scripture and the film, offered with its group count and its share so a reader can judge it. It is NOT ranked or scored, because neither proxy available here survives contact — by group count Oman picks Swahili for an Arabic-speaking people, and by population share a 10% floor refuses Urdu in Pakistan. Evidence, not advice.
